description: Quarterly statistics on the worldwide claims of internationally active banking groups by the country of their parent. The BIS data portal says the consolidated banking statistics capture the worldwide claims of banking groups based in reporting countries, excluding intragroup positions, and give several measures of country risk exposures on an immediate counterparty or guarantor basis, with foreign claims as the benchmark measure; they are quarterly, in US dollars, not seasonally adjusted, and supervised by the Committee on the Global Financial System. The series can be browsed and downloaded free on the portal, with methodology and reporting practices documented. Coverage is the BIS reporting countries and their counterparties worldwide. Caveats: the release dates and licence are not shown on the page read. For simulation it gives cross-border bank exposures between countries, for modelling how a disaster or crisis in one country hits banks headquartered elsewhere. A related catalogue record is the BIS locational banking statistics.
